definitions.explanation: Bright, colorful, or attention-grabbing in appearance; standing out through boldness.
Grand or excessive in spending or lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {派手|はで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転|ころ}んでしまった→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧。
examples.notes: {派手|はで}に = in a flashy/spectacular way

notes:
USAGE: {派手|はで} describes things that stand out visually or attract attention. It can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context.

FORMS:
- {派手|はで}な + noun (flashy ~)
- {派手|はで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (flashily, spectacularly)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {派手|はで}な⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (bright/flashy colors)
- {派手|はで}な⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (flashy clothes)
- {派手|はで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to spend lavishly)
- {派手|はで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転|ころ}ぶ→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧ (to fall spectacularly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地味|じみ}→地味：01573_jimi⟧ (plain, subdued, quiet)

NUANCE: {派手|はで} can be positive (eye-catching, impressive) or negative (gaudy, tasteless) depending on context and speaker's tone.

cross_references.label: to stand out, to be conspicuous
